fact_text: International patents on semaglutide (Ozempic) are expected to begin expiring in 2026, which opens export markets for Pakistani makers of generic versions.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Ozempic Launch in Pakistan | Which Company Is Best Positioned?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The patented Novo Nordisk pen device makes up about 50% of Ozempic's total cost, and local Pakistani makers do not use that patented pen, so their cost structure differs sharply from the import.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Ozempic Launch in Pakistan | Which Company Is Best Positioned?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The cost of one semaglutide injection is built from the active ingredient, formulation, excipients, device, packaging, cold chain and distribution, and together these set the production cost per dose.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Ozempic Launch in Pakistan | Which Company Is Best Positioned?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Semaglutide is dosed once a week, so one patient uses about 52 doses a year, which drives the volume figure in any market-size estimate.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Ozempic Launch in Pakistan | Which Company Is Best Positioned?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A new drug's market is sized as diabetic patients times the adoption rate times annual doses per patient, and the analyst uses how fast the drug was adopted in the US as a benchmark for other markets.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Ozempic Launch in Pakistan | Which Company Is Best Positioned?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst projects Pakistan's adult diabetic population to grow about 3% a year, reaching around 40 million by FY30, and treats that base as the pool for semaglutide adoption.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Ozempic Launch in Pakistan | Which Company Is Best Positioned?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In the analyst's scenario, 1% adoption among Pakistani diabetics by 2030 means about 400,000 patients on semaglutide, roughly 21 million doses a year and an industry market near PKR 80 billion.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Ozempic Launch in Pakistan | Which Company Is Best Positioned?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Semaglutide is used both for diabetes control and for weight management, which the analyst says widens the addressable patient base beyond obesity alone.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Ozempic Launch in Pakistan | Which Company Is Best Positioned?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst says the likeliest winners among local semaglutide makers are decided by two things: product price including ease of use for patients, and the strength of the international partner behind the product.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Ozempic Launch in Pakistan | Which Company Is Best Positioned?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A global partner gives a local biopharma maker credibility with buyers and a distribution network that speeds export approvals, which the analyst regards as hard for an unknown local company to obtain alone.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Ozempic Launch in Pakistan | Which Company Is Best Positioned?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Replicating a biologic or peptide injectable needs a highly trained team and dedicated biotech facilities, a batch that misses standards is lost, and such plants take about 3 to 5 years to establish.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Ozempic Launch in Pakistan | Which Company Is Best Positioned?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A biopharma injectable business runs a working-capital cycle of about three months, which the analyst includes when estimating return on capital for a plant.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Ozempic Launch in Pakistan | Which Company Is Best Positioned?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst estimates a biopharma plant's return on invested capital from three inputs: the plant itself, the international partner, and the roughly three-month working-capital cycle, with results depending on utilisation and pricing.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Ozempic Launch in Pakistan | Which Company Is Best Positioned?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: BF Biosciences started its facility in 2006 with Argentina's Bago Group as partner, initially with capacity of 15,000 injections a day.

fact_text: The analyst describes BF Biosciences as the strongest local semaglutide player, citing its first-mover advantage, its strong partner and a prefilled-syringe format that patients find convenient.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Ozempic Launch in Pakistan | Which Company Is Best Positioned?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: BF Biosciences' Bago Group partner has a presence in over 50 countries and a global distribution network, which the analyst says could open export routes for its semaglutide.

fact_text: BF Biosciences' own certification inspection is expected in July 2026, which the analyst says would allow exports to markets such as Turkey.

fact_text: In the analyst's scenario, if BF Biosciences takes 30% of an 80 billion rupee market by 2030, it earns about PKR 24 billion revenue and PKR 3.5 to 4 billion net profit, which at a 15 times pharma P/E implies a value of PKR 70 to 75 billion.

fact_text: To value a high-growth company, the analyst normalises its profit once growth matures, applies a normal P/E to that future profit, and compares the result with today's price, rather than using a high P/E on current earnings.
